title: Rooms Keys Act — payload
description: A member's own client asks the member's key holder to complete one host-bound room request — or one of the two requests by which a member takes up a community's offer of admission to a room — as the member: the member's own authority narrowed to the one action the request's type needs, the member as issuer, and the member's signature. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

document.description: The room request to complete, as the client will send it, minus its presentation and its proof.

UnsignedRoomRequest.title: Unsigned room request
UnsignedRoomRequest.description: A Trust Task document of a type in the rooms/keys/act table, built by the member's client: no proof, and no presentation in its payload. The recipient validates the payload against the named type's own schema; this one fixes only the envelope.

id.description: The request's identifier, set by the client. The host keys duplicate-execution protection on it.

type.description: The room request's Type URI: a rooms/* request, or vtc/rooms/offers/{list,accept}. Only the types in this task's table are completed; any other is `typeNotActable`.

issuer.description: The member to act as, and this task's subject (subjectPath /document/issuer). REQUIRED for a type that names no room (rooms/blobs/chunk/0.1, rooms/blobs/upload/{commit,abort}/0.2), where it is the member whose request opened the transfer; REQUIRED for the offer types (vtc/rooms/offers/list/0.1, vtc/rooms/offers/list/0.2, vtc/rooms/offers/accept/0.1), where it is the DID the community addressed its offer to; REQUIRED where the caller may act as more than one member of the room; optional where it may act as exactly one. A rule over two members this schema does not express: the recipient refuses an absent issuer it needs with principalAmbiguous. Never the client's own identifier.

recipient.description: The room's host, or for the offer types the community that made the offer: the party the completed document is for. Covered by the member's proof.

payload.description: The request's payload, as the named type's schema defines it but without `presentation`: the recipient inserts the member's own, narrowed to the table's action, where the type takes one, and refuses a payload that already carries one. For vtc/rooms/offers/accept/0.1 a `keyPackage`, where present, MUST be one the recipient minted (Recipient item 10).

Response.title: Rooms Keys Act — response payload
Response.description: Success response to rooms/keys/act. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/keys/act/0.4#response. The request, completed as the member, for the caller to send to its recipient unaltered.

principal.description: The member the recipient signed as: the completed document's `issuer`.

document.description: The supplied document with `issuer` set to the member, `payload.presentation` inserted where the type takes one, and the member's Data Integrity `proof` (`proofPurpose: authentication`). Every other member is unchanged.

expiresAt.description: When the inserted presentation's leaf lapses. Absent when the type takes no presentation.
